assertions.description: galen-bloodwork skill-run signal file was written
galen-bloodwork skill-run did not end in failure

Galen G2 (reference-range grounding): the run appended a bloodwork entry to data/health/metrics-log.json carrying the out_of_range array — the field the schema (data/health/schema.md) defines for markers flagged against their reference range. Pass = 100% of bloodwork outputs.

Galen G2: the bloodwork entry carries the structured metrics block (cardiovascular panel etc.) so every marker value is recorded against its category — the grounding data the out_of_range flags and the prior-draw comparison are computed from.

Galen G3 (longitudinal continuity): the tracking store carries bloodwork_history, the prior-draw record each new bloodwork interpretation is compared against. Honest limit: presence of the history, not that this run's comparison was correct — the correctness is the G4 Tier 3 grade.
Galen G4 (Tier 3 grade >= B): bloodwork-interpretation quality is judged by Tier 3 grading. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
